note: Towns whose own charter sets a different governing body than their state's default, by county subdivision code (county GEOID plus the subdivision's five-digit code). A town not listed takes its state's reading (township-governing-bodies.json). Rows are added from the town's charter; this file is a known-small start, one row per charter read.

0911044700.name: Manchester town, Connecticut
0911044700.citation: Manchester, Connecticut is council-manager: a Board of Directors of eight directors and a directly elected mayor (two-year terms); the board hires the Town Manager (called the General Manager until the 2022 charter, which also made the mayor directly elected).
